# Mount Kilimanjaro Guide

> > Comprehensive guide to climbing Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania, covering routes, preparation, altitude sickness prevention, and guided tour packages.

Mount Kilimanjaro Guide provides expert information for climbers planning to summit Africa's highest peak (Uhuru Peak at 5,895m). The site covers all major climbing routes including Machame, Lemosho, Marangu, Rongai, Northern Circuit, and Umbwe, with detailed itineraries, success rates, acclimatization strategies, and licensed guide services through KINAPA-certified operators.

## Key Topics

- Mount Kilimanjaro
- Uhuru Peak
- Acclimatization
- Altitude sickness (AMS)
- Lemosho Route
- Machame Route
- Marangu Route
- Rongai Route
- Northern Circuit
- Summit success rates
- KINAPA licensed guides
- Mandara Hut
- Route selection
- Best climbing seasons
- Tanzania trekking

## Getting Started

- [MOUNT KILIMANJARO GUIDE | Kilimanjaro Local Guides](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide): Homepage: Complete Kilimanjaro climbing guide covering routes, dates & prep
- [Best Kilimanjaro Climbing Packages | Affordable & Guided Treks to the Summit](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/kilimanjaro-climbing-packages): Guided trek packages for Machame, Marangu & Lemosho routes to summit
- [Best Kilimanjaro Guides: Expert-Led Mount Kilimanjaro Tours](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/best-kilimanjaro-guides-company): KINAPA-licensed guides with 98% success rate & KPAP porter ethics
- [Tanzania Kilimanjaro Tour - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/tanzania-kilimanjaro-tour): Tanzania tour packages: routes, itineraries, costs & operator selection
- [How Long Does It Take to Climb Kilimanjaro Mountain - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/how-long-does-it-take-to-climb-kilimanjaro-mountain): Climb duration guide comparing routes, acclimatization & success rates

## Climbing Routes & Itineraries

- [Kilimanjaro Route With Huts: Complete Marangu Route Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/kilimanjaro-route-with-huts): Marangu Route: only Kilimanjaro route with hut accommodations vs camping
- [Lemosho Route Success Rate - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/lemosho-route-success-rate): Lemosho Route success rates: 90% (8-day) & 85% (7-day) with AMS tips
- [Kilimanjaro Rongai Route Itinerary](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/rongai-route-3): 7-day Rongai Route itinerary from Kenya's northern approach to Uhuru Peak
- [Mount Kilimanjaro Climbing Umbwe Route](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/umbwe-route-2): Umbwe Route guide: steep, scenic & challenging climb for experienced hikers
- [Lemosho route vs Rongai route - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/lemosho-route-vs-rongai-route): Compare Lemosho & Rongai routes: scenery, acclimatization & difficulty

## Health & Safety

- [Mount Kilimanjaro Altitude Sickness: Symptoms, Prevention & Medication Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/mount-kilimanjaro-altitude-sickness): AMS prevention guide: symptoms, medication & acclimatization strategies
- [Kilimanjaro Helicopter Rescue Safety Protocols,Cost](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/kilimanjaro-helicopter-rescue): Emergency helicopter evacuation protocols, costs & safety for climbers

## Trip Planning & Logistics

- [Flights to Kilimanjaro International Airport - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/flights-to-kilimanjaro-international-airport): Flight guide to JRO airport serving Moshi & Kilimanjaro access points
- [Climbing Kilimanjaro Solo or With a Group - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/climbing-kilimanjaro-solo-or-with-a-group): Solo vs group climbing: cost comparison, private tours & planning options

## Alternative Experiences

- [Kilimanjaro Day Hike: The Ultimate Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/mount-kilimanjaro-day-hike): Guide to 6-8 hour Marangu Route day hikes to Mandara Hut without camping
- [Day Trip to Kilimanjaro from Nairobi - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/day-trip-to-kilimanjaro-from-nairobi): Nairobi to Kilimanjaro day trip: flights, Marangu hike & Chagga village
- [Mount Kilimanjaro for Senior hike - Kilimanjaro Tours for Seniors](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/mount-kilimanjaro-for-senior-hike): Senior climbing guide: age-friendly routes, safety & altitude management
- [Kilimanjaro Crater Camp - Mount Kilimanjaro Guide](https://mountkilimanjaro.guide/kilimanjaro-crater-camp-2): High-altitude Crater Camp at 5,750m: costs, routes & extreme camping info
